summary: Iteration 40: Verified async PDF bank statement upload fix. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests passed - CSV upload still synchronous returning status=completed with full analysis data; PDF async flow verified by inserting a mock 'processing' record in DB and confirming /status endpoint returns processing/failed correctly; listing endpoint includes 'status' field; 404 and auth checks pass. Frontend: Análise Bancária page loads; upload button present; mock processing item renders with 'A processar...' spinner badge, is non-clickable (no cursor-pointer, opacity-70), does NOT navigate to detail on click, and shows a delete button. Existing legacy CSV analyses render normally alongside. Did NOT test real PDF upload end-to-end (Gemini takes 3-4 min per task instructions).
critical_code_review_comments: bank_analysis.py upload endpoint (line ~679): PDF branch correctly inserts pending record with status='processing' and spawns background task via asyncio.create_task before returning immediately - no more 502 timeouts.

bank_analysis.py _finalize_analysis / _process_pdf_background: properly wrap the whole flow in try/except and update DB with status='failed' + error message on any exception, so frontend polling can surface errors gracefully.
bank_analysis.py list endpoint projection now includes 'status' and 'error' fields - needed by frontend for badge rendering.
bank_analysis.py _ai_categorize_batch (line ~348): system_message argument now correctly passed to LlmChat constructor (previously missing per problem statement).
AnaliseBancariaPage.jsx startPolling: correctly polls every 5s, clears interval on completed/failed, fetches full analysis on completion, and handles transient errors silently.

AnaliseBancariaPage.jsx list rendering (line ~229): properly guards click handler with a.status !== 'processing' && a.status !== 'failed' and applies opacity + border color to indicate non-clickable state. Delete button uses e.stopPropagation.
AnaliseBancariaPage.jsx handleUpload timeout=120000 (2 min) - could be too short if backend is slow to respond even to the immediate insert; but in practice DB insert is <1s so acceptable.

Minor: pollRef.current interval keeps running if user navigates away from page - the useEffect cleanup handles it on unmount but not on refresh; low priority since polling stops on completion/failure anyway.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all UI behaviours for processing/completed rendering verified)

seed_data_creation: Mocked processing/failed PDF records inserted directly via pymongo to simulate async flow without invoking Gemini; all TEST_ITER40 records cleaned up at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 40 verified the PDF async upload fix. Real PDF upload → Gemini extraction was NOT tested end-to-end (takes 3-4 min). To validate that path, main agent should manually upload a real BPI PDF and confirm: (1) immediate 200 response with status=processing, (2) frontend banner shows 'A extrair transações do PDF com IA...' with dots animation, (3) after 2-4 minutes the polling detects completion and opens the analysis detail. The mock-DB approach used here validates all UI branches and endpoint contracts without paying the Gemini latency cost. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter40_async_pdf.py.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: PDF uploads failed with 'Erro ao processar extrato' due to Cloudflare ~60s proxy timeout while Gemini took 2-4 min → 502. Fix decouples response from work: PDF branch inserts a pending record and spawns asyncio.create_task(_process_pdf_background) then returns {status: 'processing', id}. Frontend polls /status every 5s until status=completed|failed, then fetches full analysis. Also fixed silent AI-categorization failure (missing system_message in LlmChat).
